text:
Priya K: heads-up — saw a divergence on the month-end deferral schedule. looks like a set of prepaid partner credits were applied to customer invoices but the deferral rule wasn't created, so revenue hit immediately.
Liam T: can you share the partner and invoice samples? was this from the new partner credits workflow?
Priya K: yes, partner=EdgeRack Labs; workflow=partner-credit-batch-v2; sample rows below from billing export:
```
invoice_id,customer,invoice_date,credit_type,amount,deferral_rule
INV-2026-0512,edge-client,2026-04-11,partner-commit-credit,15000,\n
INV-2026-0520,edge-client,2026-04-18,partner-commit-credit,8000,\n
INV-2026-0529,edge-pro,2026-04-29,partner-commit-credit,6000,\n
```
Priya K: deferral_rule blank for all three — expected deferral: DEF-PARTNER-24M (24-month recognition)
Noah S: materiality?
Priya K: total $29k recognized in Apr instead of deferring; will show as overstatement in recognized revenue.
Liam T: okay, since this impacts recognized revenue, we'll need a correcting JE to move amount to deferred revenue (liability) and adjust revenue schedules. Also tag accounting for potential restatement consideration if material to any quarter.
Noah S: what's the contractual basis? are partner credits meant to be amortized?
Priya K: yes contract says partner credits provided as commit-based discounts that should be recognized over the term of the customer's committed usage — 24 months.
Liam T: steps: 1) audit the partner-credit-batch-v2 job logs and identify failed mapping that omitted deferral_rule; 2) create JE to move $29,000 from revenue to deferred revenue (DR 4000-REVENUE $29,000 / CR 2300-DEFERRED-PARTNER $29,000); 3) update revenue schedules to add DEF-PARTNER-24M amortization starting May 1; 4) determine whether to restate Apr financials or treat as prior-period adjustment with disclosure.
Priya K: i've pulled the batch log — looks like a null deferral_code when partner config had blank default. pushing a fix to partner-configs repo. will attach PR.
Noah S: for close timing: can we post JE in May close as a prior-period adjustment? does external reporting team need to be alerted?
Liam T: external reporting should be looped if the quarter-end was already reported. check dates: Apr is in the same quarter Q2 which is not closed yet; we can include correction as part of Q2 close but must document. not a restatement.
finance-bot: created ticket RR-2026-0567; assigned to @Priya K; due: 2026-05-03; required attachments: batch log, billing export, partner contract excerpt.
Priya K: attaching links: PR https://git.internal/redwood/partner-configs/pull/842; batch log snippet pasted in ticket.
Liam T: approve the JE? i approve. Noah?
Noah S: approve. please add a schedule note: "Partner credit deferral added to May amortization schedules due to omitted deferral code in partner batch"
Priya K: added note. closing loop: partner-configs PR merged; will monitor next run. thanks team.
Liam T: adding a line to the month-end memo to auditors.
Priya K: will follow up if audit asks for more detail. thanks. :white_check_mark:
